== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34786) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Moss LS Speeders.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 29 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 29 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>0949c3f80e27ab0ce057ff2957cda36505ea692ee9c72f2ef839c9931c78793f</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.
